summary.name: Humata
summary.one_liner: Humata is an AI document assistant that lets you upload files and ask questions, getting answers with citations back to the source text.
use_cases: adding a document Q&A widget to a website
sharing team files with access control
summary.what_it_does: Humata reads uploaded documents and generates answers based on their content. Each answer includes cited links to the relevant sections of the source files so the user can trace where information came from. Users can ask follow-up questions and request rewritten or shorter summaries. The page describes team features such as shared data rooms, per-role access limits, and encryption at rest. It also offers an embed option to place the document AI on a web page.
notable: Answers include citations linked to source passages in uploaded files
Embeddable document AI that can be placed on any webpage
Role-based access and shared team data rooms
Free version plus paid Student, Expert, and Team plans with some usage-based billing
caveats: Single sign-on with Okta, Google, or SAML is described as coming soon
Enterprise pricing for teams beyond 10 users requires contacting sales
Some plans include pay-as-you-go charges based on pages accessed and questions asked
